waters: Komodo, Raja Ampat, the Spice Islands, the Forgotten Islands and West Papua

seo.title: Aqua Blu: Komodo, Raja Ampat and Spice Islands Expeditions | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Aqua Blu by Aqua Expeditions: a 60 m former British naval explorer, 15 suites, 30 guests. Bali and Komodo, Raja Ampat, the Spice Islands and the Asmat, 7 to 21 nights, every fare.

tagline: A former Royal Navy explorer, fifteen suites, and the far east of Indonesia.
answer: Aqua Blu is Aqua Expeditions' 60-metre expedition yacht in Indonesia, once the British naval explorer HMS Beagle and refitted in 2019. She carries 30 guests in 15 suites with 30 crew and sails seven nights between Bali and Komodo, Raja Ampat, the Spice Islands and, on longer voyages of up to 21 nights, the Forgotten Islands and West Papua. She suits divers, snorkellers and travellers who want remote islands with a five-star ship.
facts: Former British Royal Navy explorer HMS Beagle; refitted 2019
overview: Aqua Blu began life as HMS Beagle, a British Royal Navy explorer, and was refitted for Aqua Expeditions in 2019 with interiors by Cor D. Rover. She carries 30 guests in 15 suites across five decks, with 30 crew; suites 301 and 302, and 401 and 402, connect.

She follows the weather around eastern Indonesia: Bali and Komodo from April to September, Raja Ampat from December to February, the Spice Islands of the Banda Sea between, and long voyages through the Forgotten Islands and to the Asmat of West Papua. Snorkel and scuba gear, kayaks and paddleboards are on board, and twice-daily excursions run by tender.

faqs: How much does Aqua Blu cost?
Aqua lists seven nights from about US$11,000 per person in Category III, more for the longer voyages and larger suites. Every departure is in the table on this page.
When does Aqua Blu sail Komodo and Raja Ampat?
Bali and Komodo from April to September; Raja Ampat from December to February; the Spice Islands and the Forgotten Islands in between.
Can I dive on Aqua Blu?
Yes. Scuba equipment is on board and dives are offered on the excursions; bring your certification.
Where do Aqua Blu voyages start?
Bali (Benoa), Labuan Bajo, Ambon or Sorong, depending on the route.
